messages:
alyssa: Heads-up — noticed p99 spike (~2x) on short-chat requests after yesterday's continuous-batcher token_budget_target tweak. Rolling back? cc @marcos @nina

runtime-bot: Deploy finished: batcher-heuristic-v3 -> prod, id=deploy_2026_03_17_21 :package:

marcos: Can you paste p50/p95/p99 numbers and which model/variant is affected?

alyssa: Quick numbers from the observability dashboard (slice = short chats): p50=18ms, p95=48ms, p99=210ms (baseline p99 ~=110ms). Affected model: gpt-lite-3b-int8@v12, traffic slice ~12% of prod. Mostly requests with <30 tokens. Histogram (samples):
  [0-10ms]: 34%
  [10-50ms]: 58%
  [50-200ms]: 6%
  [200ms+]: 2%

nina: I pulled batcher logs from one host (h14). Seeing a lot of single-request microbatches dispatched immediately. Pattern: token_budget calc often returns 2 tokens -> immediate dispatch with batch_size=1. Snippet: 

  $ runtime-batcher dump --host h14 --since 10m
  [batcher] enqueue req id=abc123 seq_len=12
  [batcher] computed_token_budget=2 target_batch_ms=6 queue_len=1
  [batcher] dispatching batch_size=1 reason=budget_exhausted
  [batcher] enqueue req id=def456 seq_len=8
  [batcher] computed_token_budget=2 target_batch_ms=6 queue_len=1
  [batcher] dispatching batch_size=1 reason=budget_exhausted

kai: Kernel selector logs show that for batch_size=1 we fall back to generic-fp32 kernel path instead of int8-packed optimized kernel used by multi-request batches. So single-request path pays kernel setup + slower execution. Logs: 

  kernel-selector: batch_size=1 -> kernel=generic-fp32 (latency 1.8x)
  kernel-selector: batch_size>=4 -> kernel=int8-packed (latency 0.9x)

marcos: Why is token_budget so low? We had increased the conservative cap to avoid KV-cache thrash in the last rollout. Might be that the budget calc uses median sequence length and doesn't account for prefix reuse / KV hit patterns, causing premature dispatch.

alyssa: I captured a profiling trace for a p99 sample. Flame shows ~60% of the extra time in kernel init/setup for single-batch path; KV cache hit rate for this slice also dropped from 88% -> 70% after the heuristic change (likely fewer combined prefixes getting cached).

nina: Quick experiment: set batcher.token_budget_target back to legacy 16 on h14 (canary). Command: 
  runtime-config set batcher.token_budget_target=16 --scope=host:h14
Result: number of single-request batches dropped by ~75% in 10m and p99 moved from 210ms -> ~115ms for that host.

marcos: Proposal: temporary rollback of token_budget_target heuristic in prod, then follow-up work: (1) change token_budget calc to account for expected prefix reuse (kv_hit_prob), (2) add a short micro-wait (<=8ms) when budget predicts tiny batches to give a chance for 2nd request, (3) add a fast-path kernel for batch_size=1 when int8-packed is available. Thoughts? :thumbsup:

devops: Starting rollback: batcher-heuristic-v3 -> batcher-heuristic-v2 (canary 30% then full). I'll post updates.

runtime-bot: Rollback triggered by devops: rollback_1989991250 -> success on canary nodes (30%)

alyssa: After rollback p99 samples on canary hosts ~120ms. I'll file INF-2142 for a permanent fix (token_budget algorithm + unit tests + perf test). Follow-ups: add histograms to the rollout dashboard to catch single-batch spikes earlier. Thanks all.
